title: ClinicalCraft embodied benchmark scenario (clinicalcraft/bench-scenario@1)
description: One scenario of the embodied agent benchmark (packages/content/bench/<suite>/*.json): case and facility, setup (the clinician's pose, dynamic obstacles, devices out of service, doors, staff actions, approval mode and answering policy, permission rules, practice scope), the task, success predicates evaluated on the final authoritative state, limits, the reference solver's steps and the scripted model plan.
